name: Capital Rx
verdict: Capital Rx is the pharmacy-benefit brand of Judi Health (formerly Capital Rx, Inc.), a private US health-technology company founded by AJ Loiacono and Ryan Kelly; its 2025 funding round was led by Wellington Management and General Catalyst. Nothing found.
note: NYCFC's Official Sleeve Partner since February 2024 (multi-year deal; logo on the right sleeve of first-team kits). The company rebranded as Judi Health in September 2025 and renamed the Capital Rx PBM brand Judi Rx in July 2026, but the 2026 jersey still carries Capital Rx (For Soccer's 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor survey and Blinkfire's April 2026 roundup). No human-rights finding against the company found (searched 4 Oct 2026); largest named investors are US and UK asset managers, no state or state fund among them.
